title: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
title_zh: ForcingBooster：面向快速自回归视频扩散的自适应分块去噪方法

paragraphs.en: ForcingBooster提出了一种自适应分块去噪方法，以提高自回归视频扩散模型的生成效率。 Autoregressive video diffusion models have become a leading approach to real-time interactive video generation and video world modeling. However, existing methods typically allocate computation uniformly across space when generating the next video chunk, updating all patches with the same denoising schedule and number of function evaluations. This ignores the spatial heterogeneity of video content: static, simple, or recurring regions are often easier to denoise, while other regions require further refinement or additional context. A uniform budget thus leads to redundant computation on easy patches, whereas reducing the fixed step count can leave difficult patches insufficiently refined. We introduce \methodname{}, a general framework that dynamically allocates denoising steps to individual patches: easy patches stop early to improve efficiency, while difficult patches receive more refinement steps. This design accelerates generation with negligible quality degradation. Our method is compatible with most existing few-step autoregressive diffusion models, requiring only a lightweight routing module with modest training. Experiments demonstrate that \methodname{} reduces the total number of denoising steps applied across video patches by about 50\% while maintaining visual quality comparable to the four-step baseline.
paragraphs.zh: ForcingBooster提出了一种自适应分块去噪方法，以提高自回归视频扩散模型的生成效率。自回归视频扩散模型已成为实时交互式视频生成和视频世界建模的主流方法。 然而，现有方法在生成下一个视频分块时，通常将计算资源均匀分配给整个空间，所有图像块都使用相同的去噪流程和功能评估次数进行更新。 这种方法忽略了视频内容在空间上的异质性：静态、简单或重复出现的区域通常更容易去噪，而其他区域则需要进一步细化或更多上下文信息。 因此，统一的计算预算会导致对容易处理的图像块产生冗余计算，而减少固定的步骤数则可能导致难以处理的图像块无法得到充分细化。 我们提出了 \methodname{}，一个通用框架，能够动态地将去噪步骤分配给各个图像块：容易处理的图像块可提前停止以提高效率，而难以处理的图像块则会获得更多的细化步骤。 这种设计在几乎不降低生成质量的前提下，加快了生成速度。 我们的方法与大多数现有的少步自回归扩散模型兼容，仅需一个轻量级的路由模块，且训练成本较低。 实验表明，\methodname{} 将视频各图像块上应用的去噪步骤总数减少了约50%，同时保持了与四步基线模型相当的视觉质量。
